text: Forbes's profile of Dieter Schwarz says he owns Schwarz Group and that the group is held by a foundation while he maintains full control and is the effective owner.
short: Schwarz Group is owned by Dieter Schwarz via a foundation.

source.name: Forbes - Dieter Schwarz profile
source.quote: Schwarz Group is owned by a foundation, technically a limited liability company, but Dieter maintains full control and is the effective owner.
